notes: RULE 3 / ownership check: habitat.co.uk does NOT redirect to Argos. Habitat runs its own live storefront on its own domain; only the platform underneath is shared with Argos (Akamai response header x-argos-brand: hab, product imagery on media.4rgos.it, a handful of 'Argos Home' branded SKUs in the curtain-pole listing). Every link below is a canonical habitat.co.uk origin URL. ACCESS: plain curl is Akamai 403 on every path including robots.txt and sitemap.xml; curl_cffi browser impersonation returned 200 on the first try with every one of 13 profiles swept, so chrome131 was used throughout. No proxy or reader service was needed. TREE: recovered from /main_sitemap.xml (1,235 URLs, 262 base category nodes) cross-checked against the mega-menu taxonomy in window.__HABITAT_INITIAL_PROPS__. Two sitemap entries are stale and 404 live: tableware/jugs-and-decanters c:809314 (redirects to a 'measuring-jugs' slug, still 404) and garden/garden-mirrors c:1042944; both are treated as retired. COUNTS: taken from the rendered listing header, span data-test="result-count" ('N products'). Verified empirically three ways rather than assumed: (1) exhaustion - the page's own JSON-LD ItemList was crawled across all pages for every single category emitted, and the unique product-ID count equalled the header exactly in all 28 cases (e.g. Tableware 60+60+60+60+60+11 = 311); (2) ceil(N/60) equalled the page's rendered page count on every category; (3) one page past the end returns HTTP 404 (checked on Tableware p7, Wall mirrors p3, Lamp shades p3). Note that counting raw /product/ hrefs OVERCOUNTS here because recommendation carousels inject extra links, so the JSON-LD ItemList was used for the ID sets instead. SUBSET/RE-CUT CHECKS (by product-ID set comparison, not by name): Frames and wall art 136+12=148 and Vases and ornaments 31+13=44 are exact partitions of their parents. Mirrors children union to exactly the 90-item parent; the only overlaps are 2 of 5 Full length mirrors and 1 of 5 Bathroom mirrors also sitting in Wall mirrors, so these are genuine distinct listings, not a Perigold-style re-cut. Table and desk lamps: 4 of the 7 Desk lamps also sit in Table lamps (116+7 union to the 119 parent). Tableware children overlap each other by design (a dinner set is also indexed under Bowls/Plates), union 249 of the 311 parent - each child is still its own real listing, and only leaves carry qty so nothing is double-counted at parent level. DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED: Candles c:809254 (98) - all 98 product titles were read and 92 are scented fragrance SKUs (Pink Jasmine & Amber, Patchouli & Plum, etc.); only 6 are labelled Unscented and the site offers no unscented child listing, only scent-type: filters, so the whole node is dropped per the World Market precedent. Its sibling Candle holders (12, all hurricanes/candlesticks/lanterns) is kept. Kids lighting c:828066 (20) - dropped as a pure re-cut: 16 of its 20 items are already in Lamp shades and the other 4 in Table and desk lamps. Garden planters and pots c:809285 (24) - dropped, mixed outdoor gardening roll-up (Forest/Strata/Sankey lattice and plastic planters plus one artificial-flower basket) and 6 of the 10 Indoor planters are already inside it; Indoor planters and pots (10) is kept instead. Outdoor lighting c:824712 (38) and its three children - dropped, the titles are almost entirely solar stake/string/garden lights (functional outdoor illumination) and the children overlap (46 summing into a 38 parent). LED lighting c:1000194 (6) - dropped as a mixed roll-up of desk lamps, bathroom demister mirrors and recessed spotlights already counted elsewhere. Also excluded per brief: cafetieres (18, coffee-making device), travel mugs (2, thermal flasks), cutlery (13, flatware), bathroom mirrors (5) and bathroom lights (13), light bulbs, light switches, ceiling fans, all fragrance nodes (reed/electric diffusers, room spray), artificial plants, wallpaper, Christmas/holiday nodes, gift cards, storage baskets and boxes, table linen, cookware, kitchen accessories, textiles and furniture. Garden ornaments is kept despite sitting in the Garden branch because its single product is decorative metal wall art, which the brief lists as in scope. RULE 0 TOP-UP (2026-08-10): the original pass, predating Rule 0, dropped three room-based lighting/mirror branches purely for their room word; all three are genuinely in-scope product types (mirrors, lighting) and are restored here with fresh live counts. (1) Bathroom mirrors c:1000192 - re-fetched, still 5 products (Habitat Matte Black Metal Round Pedestal Swivel Mirror, Mango Wood Bathroom Mirror with Shelf, Bathroom LED Backlit Demister Touch Mirror, etc.) - genuine wall/vanity mirrors, added as a leaf under the existing Mirrors parent per Rule 0.3/0.4. (2) Bathroom lights c:1000302 - re-fetched, 13 products (flush ceiling lights, wall lights, spotlights for bathroom use) - genuine light fixtures, added as a Lighting leaf per Rule 0.1/0.4. (3) Outdoor lighting c:824712 - re-fetched, parent still 38 products; its three children were re-verified live: Fairy lights and string lights c:824713 = 9, Outdoor wall lights and lanterns c:1054961 = 2, Solar garden lights c:1028098 = 35 (children sum 46, overlapping the 38 parent by design, same overlap pattern already documented above for Tableware/Mirrors - each child is still a distinct real listing). Rule 0.5 explicitly states 'outdoor lighting of every kind' is IN scope, which reverses the original pass's 'functional illumination' rationale for dropping this node; parent added as parent:true (qty null, matching this file's convention of only leaves carrying qty) with its three children as leaf rows. VERIFICATION METHOD for all 6 new rows: same as the rest of this file - rendered listing header 'N products' cross-checked against the page's own embedded ItemList JSON-LD (numberOfItems + count of unique /product/ID entries in itemListElement), which matched exactly in every case; all six categories fit on a single page (qty <= 60) so no pagination was needed. NOT FOUND: swept the full main_sitemap.xml base-category list (262 nodes) again for vanity/bedroom/hallway/entryway/recessed/track/cabinet/picture-light/kitchen-island/landscape/patio room-lighting or room-mirror branches not already in this file or already deliberately excluded above (LED lighting, Kids lighting) - none exist; Habitat has no other missing room-based lighting/mirror branch. Access notes still hold: plain HTTPS GET via the requests-based probe harness returned 200 on every URL touched in this top-up, no impersonation or proxy needed this session.
